propositions: Four graph functions (_find_direct_blockers, _get_all_blocked_by, check_cycle_at_level, detect_newly_unblocked) have elevated cyclomatic complexity (16-22) that can be reduced to ≤8 via duplication elimination and helper extraction.

An identical "reduce_all_tickets → drop error/fsck_needed → index by id" loop is duplicated verbatim in _find_direct_blockers and _compute_dep_graph; extracting it as load_indexed_states removes this duplication.

Two graph functions re-implement identical BFS/traversal skeletons; consolidating them into a shared accumulator-returning bfs helper that accepts a neighbors_fn callback preserves node-set and traversal semantics while lowering CCN.

The refactor must maintain behavior-preserving equivalence: existing test suites pass unchanged, new characterization tests verify that _get_all_blocked_by includes unreachable blocks targets and excludes the seed node.
All four target functions must measure CCN ≤8 (or ≤12 for detect_newly_unblocked) after refactor, as verified by complexity-baseline.json regeneration.
